class: a ground moved and the claim was not revisited

expect.why: the note the claim rests on was remeasured after the pin; the claim may or may not survive it, and nobody has said which
the correct human act is a fresh corroborated entry pinned to the new note, or a contested verdict; the flag exists to force the choice

history: apply commits/01, commits/02, … as successive commits in a fresh repository; expectations name the commit they apply to. `@commitNN` in an entry is substituted with the real short object id of that commit before it is made, because a seed cannot know an id the runner has not created yet
